config.dtype: float16 on cuda (weights loaded fp32 on CPU for the fp32 asserts, then half)
config.compare_question: Question: Which name has the largest code: alpha, gamma or delta? Answer:
config.recall_question: Question: What is the alpha code? Answer:

filler_pool.source: wikitext-103-raw-v1 train split, hub parquet cache

sha256.hash: sha256 of the UTF-8 text; prompts in item order per cell; codes and sentences sorted by hash

items.nesting_note: items are generated per distance from the item seed plus D: the filler at D = 16 is not the head of any other distance's filler and the codes are drawn afresh per distance; an item is shared across the two families, every variant and both arms at one distance only (zoo section 8 item 3)

controls_at_D1.near: the item's own filler stands between the exemplars and the code block; a fresh 16-token filler stands between the block and the question (C_near, compare only)
controls_at_D1.overwrite: the item's filler keeps its head; its last sentence is 'The {name} code is now {code}.' for a name that is not the correct slot and a code larger than all three; scored against the original correct slot; the fraction answering the re-planted name is reported (C_overwrite, compare only)

exploratory.reason: decision 2 default: no M3 arm; state-spaces/mamba3-siso-1.5b is not runnable on Windows as shipped (Triton, mamba-ssm absent) and was not approved

main_region_disjoint.by_construction: the pilot2 slice is cut from the seeded sentence order before the main region is read; every sentence drawn lies inside it (asserted); the pilot2 code pools are cut before the main test pool

chunked_scan.note: slow path in use on every device

pilot_rule: amendment 17.2: the one bounded redesign, the last; if both arms clear the 0.4 screen (compare and recall normalized accuracy at D0) and the max-slot <= 0.8 guard, the format line is set to 'argmax_largest' and the main run may proceed only after the seal and the operator's anchor; otherwise the format line is set to NOT_STARTED (final) and the behavioural route is closed by the operator's rule; these numbers license nothing else
